name: A challenge with NO_REALM_BANK refuses the Realm Bank vault, its deposits and its tab voucher
contract: Hardcore (challenge 54) and 60 other challenges declare CHALLENGE_RULES_TYPE_NO_REALM_BANK, but no code enforced it: a challenger could summon the Realm Bank (item 1180097, spell 92078) and move items between the account's characters.

Expected: AscensionPersonalBank::CanAccess is asked when a vault opens, for every packet to a vault that is already open, and when the Realm Bank Tab Voucher (1180485) is used. The challenge guard refuses the Realm Bank kind while the rule is active and tells the player why.
Control: before the challenge starts, the vault opens and takes a deposit, and the voucher is consumed.
Only deposits are used before the challenge: a Realm Bank withdrawal marks OUTSIDE_REALM_BANK, which would block the Hardcore start.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Acquire the Realm Bank
Carry two Realm Bank Tab Vouchers
Carry a control item
Summon the Realm Bank vault
Let the vault summon land in the world
Control: open the vault outside any challenge
Control: deposit into the open vault
Control: the vault opened and took the deposit
Control: use a tab voucher outside any challenge
Control: the voucher is consumed
Control: no challenge refusal outside a challenge
steps.text: Your challenge forbids using the realm bank.

steps.label: Start Hardcore (NO_REALM_BANK) with the vault still open
Carry a second control item
DISCRIMINATING: deposit into the vault opened before the challenge
The open vault refuses the deposit
The challenge says why
steps.text: Your challenge forbids using the realm bank.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: use a tab voucher during Hardcore
The voucher is kept and no tab is added
DISCRIMINATING: reopen the vault during Hardcore
Deposit after the refused reopen
The vault stays closed
